messages:
alice: quick q — i opened a PR to switch our secrets wiring in k8s from SealedSecrets -> ExternalSecrets backed by Vault. reason: easier rotation and no manual unseal. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345. tagging here for infra-side checks. first pass Terraform adds aws_iam_role for externalsecrets + Vault policy. any red flags?

ben: looked at the PR, nice. two quick things: what Vault auth method are you using? aws-iam or kubernetes-auth? also how will rotation be triggered — TTL vs explicit rotate?

alice: using kubernetes-auth for pod identities (service account -> Vault role). rotation plan is to leverage Vault's dynamic secrets for db credentials (TTL renewed) and use Transit + periodic re-wrapping for static tokens. for k/v secrets we plan to put a metadata key and rotate with a lambda that calls `/v1/secret/data/...` re-write and bump version. open to suggestions.

carol: hmm for static API keys we should prefer dynamic creds where possible. for things that must be static (third-party services) maybe use ExternalSecrets with a transformation so k8s secret is regenerated when the Vault secret version changes. ExternalSecrets has `refreshInterval` and `target.template` — we can hook into that.

dave: on the Terraform side we need to ensure the iam role has sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity if we use IRSA. PR shows an aws_iam_role but no aws_iam_role_policy_attachment for the vault policy. also ensure the OIDC provider thumbprint matches prod cluster. small ops mistake burned us before.

alice: good catch, adding attachments. current plan: create a dedicated SA per namespace `es-bridge-<ns>` and bind a Vault role to the SA. Terraform snippet added in PR: ```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "es_bridge" {
  metadata {
    name = "es-bridge-${var.namespace}"
    namespace = var.namespace
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.es_bridge.arn
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "es_bridge" {
  name = "es-bridge-${var.namespace}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role.json
}
```

ben: can we add a Vault policy example too? I want to review least-priv. maybe: ```hcl
path "kv/data/apps/${var.namespace}/*" {
  capabilities = ["read","list"]
}
path "database/creds/redwood-role" { capabilities = ["read"] }
```

alice: adding. also for prod we will keep a small set of sealed-secrets-enabled namespaces during cutover to avoid downtime. migration plan in PR description: 1) deploy ExternalSecrets operator (v0.7.1) with Helm values (rbac + CRDs), 2) create es-bridge SA + Vault bindings, 3) create ExternalSecret resources pointing at Vault paths, 4) monitor refresh and rollout, 5) delete sealed-secrets after 2 weeks.

carol: two operational notes: - make sure ExternalSecrets operator is configured with `syncPolicy: CreateOrUpdate` and `invalidateOnChange` if supported. - set `refreshInterval` to 1m for staging, 10m for prod initially.

dave: what about pod restarts upon secret change? ExternalSecrets writes k8s secrets; we need an automated rollout for deployments. we can add an annotation on the k8s secret like `restartedAt` updated by a controller or use kubelet's projected volumes to pick up changes. any preference?

alice: prefer a lightweight rollout controller that watches secrets and patches deployments (same NS) with an annotation `secrets.redwood/restart=<ts>`. I can add a small controller as a lambda-triggered job or k8s cronjob. open to using flagger if people prefer.

ben: for review, pinging @carol to confirm Vault policy lgtm and @dave to validate IAM bits. I'm :eyes: on the Helm values for ExternalSecrets.

vault-bot: [vault] policy applied: es-bridge-prod -> policy-id: p-07a3f (read only to kv/data/apps/prod/*).

alice: updated PR with the policy attachment and the restart-controller TODO. also added `helm_release` for externalsecrets operator with values: ```yaml
controller:
  replicas: 2
  logLevel: info
  syncPeriod: 1m
  providers:
    - name: vault
      type: vault
      server: https://vault.redwood-internal:8200
      auth:
        kubernetes:
          role: "es-bridge-${var.namespace}"
```

carol: quick nit — use at least 3 replicas for HA in prod cluster size > 3 zones. also add resource requests for the controller.

dave: i will test the terraform change in a scratch cluster (testing account) and run `terraform plan` + `apply` to validate OIDC thumbprint and role binding. will report back in this thread.

alice: thank you — if all good i'll merge PR tomorrow and schedule the operator rollout during low traffic window. cc: @ben @carol for final thumbs. :thumbsup:

ben: will do review now.

carol: LGTM after the replica + resource request change. :shipit:
